name: cctv_cut_in
note: SYNTHETIC render of a hand-built 2D sim trace (viz/isaac/cctv_sample.py). Not real footage, not a real crash. Post-impact motion is illustrative, not simulated.

camera.model: pinhole, no distortion, square pixels; yaw from +x towards +y, pitch below horizontal

calibration.note: click order A, B, C, D: A = near end on the camera-side (right) lane line of the middle lane, B = far end on the same line, C = across from B on the far-side lane line, D = across from A. Each point is the end of a 3 m dash FARTHER from the camera (dashes run x = 12k..12k+3 m), centre of the 0.12 m line. L = 24 m (two 12 m dash periods), W = 3.5 m line centre to line centre.

truth.post_impact: from t=5.52 s: illustrative roll-out (restitution 0.3, 6.0 m/s^2 braking), NOT simulated by sim/
truth.background_vehicle: track 'traffic' in the nearside lane at 16 m/s, not involved
